windows.name: Windows x64 (64-bit)
windows.notes: NSIS installer. Per-user install, no admin required. SmartScreen will warn because this build is unsigned. This entry is the locally install-tested build; a CI-built Windows installer (sha256 43a5eb7db968faa26561ad9df793882e7de89d1da74b68c627187be1bd3339bf, 121780566 bytes) also exists as a GitHub Actions artifact (run 44431591087, 2026-11-19) but is not publicly distributed.
windows.installation: Run Keel-Setup-0.1.0.exe. Accept the installer prompts. Launch from the Start Menu shortcut or Desktop shortcut.

macos.name: macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon)
macos.notes: CI-built and checksummed in GitHub Actions run 44431591087 (2026-11-19). arm64 only; Intel Macs untested. Unsigned, so Gatekeeper will block first launch (right-click > Open, or a future notarized build). Not publicly distributed. Do not download from unofficial sources.

linux.name: Linux x64
linux.notes: CI-built and checksummed in GitHub Actions run 44431591087 (2026-11-19). Untested on desktop Linux; the matching .deb (sha256 15f5db415248ef8d36687b224b19033568890bce67cbc52a5b06f3ad41b04b3e) is also built. Not publicly distributed. Do not download from unofficial sources.

__hosting__: Installers are not yet hosted publicly. Keel-controlled object storage/CDN is the intended distribution channel; upload and public URLs will be added when hosting credentials are provided. See docs/HOSTING.md.
